Private Function Tried(ByVal which As Long, ByVal folder As String, ByVal out As String) As String

    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet): Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Select Case which
    Case 0

    Case 1
        Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddPicture(folder & "\dpi96.jpg", msoFalse, msoTrue, 10, 10, -1, -1)
    Case 2
        Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddPicture(folder & "\dpi72.jpeg", msoFalse, msoTrue, 10, 10, -1, -1)

    Case 18
        Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddPicture(folder & "\none.jpg", msoFalse, msoTrue, 10, 10, 100, 40): Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddPicture(folder & "\plain.gif", msoFalse, msoTrue, 10, 10, 100, 40): Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddPicture(folder & "\shown.png", msoFalse, msoTrue, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 19

    Case 20
        Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddPicture(folder & "\shown.png", msoFalse, msoTrue, 10, 10, 100, 40): sh.PictureFormat.Brightness = 0

    Case 26

    Case 27

    Case 36
        Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddPicture(folder & "\shown.png", msoFalse, msoTrue, 10, 10, 100, 40): sh.PictureFormat.ColorType = 2
    Case 37

    Case 48
        Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddPicture(folder & "\shown.png", msoFalse, msoTrue, 10, 10, 100, 40): sh.PictureFormat.CropLeft = 0
    Case 49

    Case 50

    Case 51

    Case 52
        Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddPicture(folder & "\shown.png", msoFalse, msoTrue, 10, 10, 100, 40): sh.PictureFormat.TransparencyColor = 255: sh.PictureFormat.TransparentBackground = msoTrue
    Case 53
        Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddPicture(folder & "\shown.png", msoFalse, msoTrue, 10, 10, 100, 40): sh.PictureFormat.TransparentBackground = msoTrue: sh.PictureFormat.TransparencyColor = 255
    Case 54
        Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddPicture(folder & "\shown.png", msoFalse, msoTrue, 10, 10, 100, 40): sh.PictureFormat.Brightness = 0.7: sh.PictureFormat.Contrast = 0.7
    Case 55
        Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddPicture(folder & "\shown.png", msoFalse, msoTrue, 10, 10, 100, 40): sh.PictureFormat.Contrast = 0.7: sh.PictureFormat.Brightness = 0.7
    Case 56
        Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddPicture(folder & "\shown.png", msoFalse, msoTrue, 10, 10, 100, 40): sh.PictureFormat.ColorType = 2: sh.PictureFormat.Brightness = 0.7
    Case 57
        Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddPicture(folder & "\shown.png", msoFalse, msoTrue, 10, 10, 100, 40): sh.PictureFormat.Brightness = 0.7: sh.PictureFormat.ColorType = 2
    Case 58
        Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddPicture(folder & "\shown.png", msoFalse, msoTrue, 10, 10, 100, 40): sh.PictureFormat.CropLeft = 10: sh.PictureFormat.CropRight = 5: sh.PictureFormat.CropTop = 3: sh.PictureFormat.CropBottom = 2
    Case 59

    Case 69

    Case 70

    Case 72

    Case 73

    End Select

    v = TypeName(sh)

    s = s & "|" & v

    Err.Clear

    v = sh.PictureFormat.Crop.PictureOffsetY
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    On Error GoTo 0
    Tried = s
    wb.SaveAs out & "\c" & which & ".xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    wb.Close False
    Exit Function
Failed:
    s = "Err " & Err.Number
    Resume Measured
End Function

Public Function Probe(ByVal folder As String, ByVal out As String) As String
    Dim i As Long, s As String
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    For i = 0 To 73
        s = s & "@@@" & Tried(i, folder, out)
    Next
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Probe = Mid(s, 4)
End Function
